title.zh: 万事达卡推出稳定币风险筛查服务Stablecoin Security
title.en: Mastercard launches Stablecoin Security risk-screening service

current_state.zh: Mastercard launched Stablecoin Security, a risk-screening service that combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks and payment providers detect fraud, sanctions exposure, and other risks before stablecoin transactions settle.
current_state.en: Mastercard launched Stablecoin Security, a risk-screening service that combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks and payment providers detect fraud, sanctions exposure, and other risks before stablecoin transactions settle.

updates.title_zh: Mastercard Brings Its Fraud-Fighting Tools to Stablecoin Payments
updates.title_en: Mastercard Brings Its Fraud-Fighting Tools to Stablecoin Payments
updates.what_changed_zh: Mastercard unveiled Stablecoin Security, an API-based risk-intelligence service built with Borderless.xyz and Keyrails that scores stablecoin payments for fraud, scams and sanctions exposure before settlement, launching first in North America with global availability planned for 2027.
